note: Each bar is normalised to 100%, so segments are each employer's share of that row's role-holders; the dashed line marks 50%. Rows are ordered most-concentrated first. The six largest employers get their own colour; smaller ones pool into 'Other orgs'. The data view shows the underlying counts.
methodology: For each repository, take the people holding the selected role there (the tabs pick maintainer or committer).
Map each to an organisation via the affiliations file.

Count holders per organisation within the repo; the largest employers across all repos get their own colour, the rest pool into 'Other orgs', and solo/unmapped holders show as 'Independent'/'Unknown'.
Normalise each repo's counts to 100% and stack them into one bar, ordered most-concentrated first (by the largest single employer's share); ties are grouped by the leading organisation's colour.
A dashed line marks 50%: a segment past it means one employer holds the majority. Single-colour bars are single-employer repos; multi-colour bars are cross-org.
population: People holding the maintainer role in each repository, by curated employer; a person is counted in every repository where they hold it.
